The '''''Valiant''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] that served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was present at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] [[Calenz]] in the [[Nocto system/Legends|Nocto system]] not long before the [[Battle of Nocto]].
